text: Perceive the creative process as the highest form of prayer. The process of creativity, when you are in the flow, is your most sincere communication with God. When you notice the slightest wave of creative inspiration, treat it with maximum attention, understanding that God has made contact. And adjust your perception of what is happening - so as not to expect a result, but to receive joy and satisfaction in the current moment - from the very process of union with the creative force of the Universe. Creative crises in this context are not a failure or a problem, but a call to deeper humility, sincerity, and purification of the channel of communication with God.
